# Copilot Instructions
- Act as a senior .NET 8 WPF/MVVM engineer.

## Project Guidelines
- The user prefers English group labels in the history UI.
- All generated code should follow clean-code principles.
- Keep the `Domain`, `Presentation`, and `Services` layers separated.
- Always use braces even for single-line code blocks.
- Comments must be written in English.
- Chat responses must be in Hungarian.
- When possible, use the existing color palette for design changes.
